ITEM 1 | Golden-brown breaded or pan-fried piece with darker crusty edges and flecks of green and red herbs/pepper bits on the surface, irregular shape about 7 x 5 cm, slightly domed, sitting at the upper left of the plate | 110
ITEM 2 | Large pan-seared piece with deep brown crisp surface and browned edges, roughly 8 x 6 cm, thick (about 3 cm), with a fibrous, flaky-looking interior edge visible at the top right, resting on the right side of the plate near the tomatoes | 130
ITEM 3 | Pale cream-to-tan piece with a browned, slightly crusted outer side and a smooth lighter interior, about 8 x 5 cm and roughly 3 cm thick, lying across the lower center of the plate on top of lettuce | 120
ITEM 4 | Pale yellow, soft-looking cube-shaped pieces with slightly rough edges, about 3 x 3 cm total footprint, sitting at the left edge on lettuce | 25
ITEM 5 | Crisp, bright green curly leaves forming a loose bed across the left and lower part of the plate, some leaves pale yellow-green at the center, moist with a slight sheen, covering roughly 20% of the plate | 60
ITEM 6 | Halved and whole cherry tomatoes with glossy red skins and pale seed pockets, plus thin strips of red and orange bell pepper, moist and juicy, forming a cluster about 9 x 6 cm at the lower right | 70
ITEM 7 | Small dark brown oval object with a smooth, slightly glossy surface, about 2.5 x 1.5 cm, sitting alone at the top center of the plate | 5
ITEM 8 | Thin orange-red strips of pepper with soft, slightly glossy texture scattered among the lettuce and beside the breaded piece, about 6 cm total length, small amount | 8
